text.offer: Drechx says, "Upstairs you'll find the bones of the king's guard, battered and broken but still walking. A blunt weapon serves best against them. Break ten, and you'll be ready for what holds the main hall."
text.progress: The zombies and battered skeletons walk the rooms upstairs in Castle Victoria, up the stairs from the main hall.
text.complete: Drechx says, "Ten. Good. Bones break, if you hit them hard enough."

steps.objective: Battered skeletons broken upstairs in Castle Victoria
